test_title: PYST 44 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the option that is the most appropriate conversion of the following sentence into Active Voice.

The students were made to rewrite the entire assignment.

options.text: The The teacher made the students rewrite the entire assignment.
The teacher makes the students rewrite the entire assignment.
The teacher is making the students rewrite the entire assignment.
The teacher has made the students rewrite the entire assignment.

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. The teacher made the students rewrite the entire assignment .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **passive voice**, where the action is being done to the students.
 
• To convert the sentence into the **active voice**, the subject performing the action (the teacher) must be mentioned first.
 
• The **verb tense** must remain consistent when converting from passive to active voice. Here, "were made" (past tense passive) is converted to "made" (past tense active).

Correct sentence: *The teacher made the students rewrite the entire assignment*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Active Voice:**

 
 
• **Definition:** The subject performs the action mentioned by the verb.
 
• **Example:** The teacher made the students rewrite the assignment.
 
• **Usage:** Active voice sentences are direct and concise.
 
 
 
• **Passive Voice:**
 
 
• **Definition:** The subject receives the action performed by the verb.
 
• **Example:** The students were made to rewrite the assignment.
 
• **Usage:** Passive voice is used when the focus is on the action rather than the subject.
